private_lines.Sam: You work as a sales manager for a logistics firm, spending your days in client calls and office meetings, and you live alone in a condo in Sukhumvit, where you usually get home by early evening and spend evenings planning trips or catching up on messages.
private_lines.Nathan: You work as a paramedic on rotating shifts with an ambulance service in Bangkok, so your days are often built around night or early-morning shifts, and you live alone in a small flat in Ari, spending your time off doing errands, the gym and seeing friends when you can.
private_lines.Dev: You work as a junior accountant at a Big Four firm's Bangkok office, where your days are spent on audit files and client spreadsheets, and you live alone in a studio apartment in Thonglor, usually coming home in the evening to cook simple meals and watch shows.
private_lines.Simon: You work as a solicitor at a commercial law firm in Silom, spending your days on contracts and client calls, and you live alone in a condo near Sathorn, where you usually head home at a reasonable hour and spend evenings reading or cooking with the TV on.
private_lines.Jordan: You coach youth football for a club in Bangkok, so your mornings and early afternoons are spent on training and matches, and you share a flat in Phra Khanong with a colleague from the club who isn't in this chat, with evenings often spent at the gym or out with friends.
private_lines.Oscar: You are a chef at a restaurant in Ari, working late evenings and early mornings in the kitchen, and you live alone in a flat in the same neighbourhood, spending your days off at the market, sleeping in and catching up with friends over food.
